UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with hydration preferences, streak metrics, and unlocked cactus garden data.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the user matching request.auth.uid

servingSize.description: Default water serving size per Fill Up tap in ml

currentStreak.description: Consecutive days with achieved hydration target

totalSuccessfulDays.description: Total number of successful hydration days completed

lastHydrationDate.description: Date of latest recorded hydration activity in YYYY-MM-DD

activeCactusId.description: Identifier of currently selected cactus variety

customPots.description: Map of cactus variety IDs to chosen pot design IDs

notificationSettings.description: Reminder settings including frequency, start/end hours, and push sound

unlockedCacti.description: List of unlocked cactus varieties IDs

unlockedBadges.description: List of unlocked achievement badges IDs

lifetimeTaps.description: Total lifetime Fill Up water taps recorded by user

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was last updated

DailyRecord.title: DailyRecord
DailyRecord.description: Daily hydration entries, tap counts, and cactus growth status for a given calendar date.

date.description: Local calendar date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

totalIntake.description: Total water consumed today in ml

goal.description: Hydration target for the day in ml

goalAchieved.description: Whether the daily hydration target has been met

tapsCount.description: Number of Fill Up taps recorded today

cactusGrowthPercentage.description: Cactus growth percentage today (each tap adds 5%, max 100%)

drinks.description: List of timestamped drink entries recorded today

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the most recent drink entry

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and hydration streak state

/users/{userId}/dailyRecords/{recordId}.description: Daily hydration records and historical intake logs
